install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing batch image conversion, montage, annotation and format support scripts.
cautions: Apply a restrictive policy.xml (disable MSL/URL/PS coders) before processing untrusted input.
Shelling out: pass arguments as arrays, never interpolated strings.
install: Download from the official site or OS package manager; verify checksums/signatures and record the version.

items.name: Fontsource

license.scope: MIT for Fontsource tooling; each font package carries its font license (mostly OFL-1.1).

items.summary: Self-hostable open-source fonts (including all of Google Fonts) packaged as npm modules.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hotlinking font CDNs or hand-writing @font-face rules and subsetting.
cautions: Import only the weights/subsets you need to limit bundle size.
install: Install the specific @fontsource/<family> (or @fontsource-variable/<family>) package; @fontsource/inter is an example.

items.name: unDraw

license.scope: Custom unDraw license: free use including commercial, but not for building competing illustration libraries or bulk redistribution.

items.summary: Library of open-use SVG illustrations with a customizable accent color.
items.useWhen: Use instead of commissioning generic spot illustrations for empty states, onboarding and landing pages.
cautions: Read the license: no redistribution as an illustration pack or use in competing services.
install: Download chosen illustrations from undraw.co and commit them with a note of the source and license.

items.name: Open Peeps

license.scope: Released under CC0 (public domain dedication) by Pablo Stanley.

items.summary: Hand-drawn mix-and-match people illustration library released into the public domain.
items.useWhen: Use instead of drawing character illustrations or avatars from scratch for friendly, cartoon-style UI.
cautions: Confirm the CC0 notice on the download source and keep a provenance note.
install: Download the asset pack from the official site; commit selected SVGs with a provenance note.

items.name: Puppeteer
items.summary: Node.js API to control Chrome/Firefox over CDP/WebDriver BiDi for automation, PDFs and screenshots.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing CDP clients for headless screenshots, PDF rendering, form automation or crawling.
cautions: Downloads a browser on install; pin versions and cache in CI.
Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Selenium
items.summary: W3C WebDriver browser automation with bindings for Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, Ruby and Grid for scale.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing WebDriver protocol clients for cross-browser automation in non-JS stacks.
cautions: Selenium Manager downloads drivers automatically; pin browser/driver versions in CI.
Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: WebdriverIO
items.summary: Node.js automation framework for browsers and native mobile apps (via Appium) over WebDriver/BiDi.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing WebDriver/Appium glue for web plus mobile automation from one JS codebase.
cautions: Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Crawlee
items.summary: Node.js and Python crawling library with request queues, retries, proxies and HTTP/browser crawlers.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing crawl queues, retry/backoff, session rotation and storage for scrapers.
cautions: Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
Its fingerprinting/proxy features must not be used to evade blocks a site has deliberately applied.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Scrapy
items.summary: Python framework for fast, structured crawling with spiders, pipelines and auto-throttling.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing Python crawl loops, deduplication, throttling and export pipelines.
cautions: Keep ROBOTSTXT_OBEY enabled and AutoThrottle on.
Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Beautiful Soup
items.summary: Python library for parsing and navigating HTML/XML documents, tolerant of broken markup.
items.useWhen: Use instead of regex-based HTML extraction in Python.
cautions: Parsing only; fetch with requests/httpx and respect site terms.
Use the lxml parser for speed on large documents.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Cheerio
items.summary: Fast jQuery-like HTML/XML parsing and manipulation for Node.js without a browser.
items.useWhen: Use instead of regex HTML parsing or launching a headless browser for static pages.
cautions: Does not execute JavaScript; use Puppeteer/Playwright for client-rendered pages.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: jsdom
items.summary: Pure-JavaScript implementation of DOM and HTML standards for Node.js.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing DOM shims for server-side HTML processing or DOM-based tests.
cautions: Never enable runScripts: "dangerously" on untrusted HTML.
No layout/rendering; use a real browser for visual checks.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Browserless

license.scope: SSPL-1.0 or commercial license; free for non-commercial/open-source use, commercial use requires a license.

items.summary: Headless Chrome/Firefox/WebKit as a Docker service or hosted API for Puppeteer/Playwright clients.
items.useWhen: Use instead of building your own browser pool, queueing and session management service.
cautions: SSPL/commercial terms: review before offering it inside a commercial or hosted product.
Set a TOKEN and network isolation; an open instance is a free proxy for attackers.
install: Review the license; run the official image pinned to a tag with TOKEN set from secrets, or use the hosted service.

items.name: Browser Use

license.scope: MIT for the library; the cloud service is separate.

items.summary: Python library that lets LLM agents control a real browser to complete web tasks.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing LLM-to-DOM action loops for agentic browsing.
cautions: Agents act with the browser profile's credentials; use isolated profiles and confirm consequential actions.
Model calls cost money per step; set step and budget limits.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Stagehand

license.scope: MIT for the SDK; Browserbase hosting is a paid service.

items.summary: TypeScript browser automation SDK mixing code with natural-language act/extract/observe steps.
items.useWhen: Use instead of brittle hand-written selectors when pages change often, keeping deterministic code where possible.
cautions: LLM steps are non-deterministic and billed; cache actions and validate extracted data.
Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Skyvern

license.scope: AGPL-3.0 for the open-source core; the cloud product is commercial.

items.summary: LLM and computer-vision driven browser workflow automation with an API and UI.
items.useWhen: Use instead of building vision-based form filling and multi-step browser workflows from scratch.
cautions: AGPL-3.0: offering a modified version over a network requires sharing source.
Consequential actions (purchases, submissions) need human confirmation.
install: Review AGPL obligations; self-host from a pinned release with its Docker Compose setup.

items.name: Firecrawl

license.scope: AGPL-3.0 for the server; official SDKs are MIT; hosted API is a paid service.

items.summary: Crawling/scraping API that turns websites into clean Markdown or structured data for LLMs.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing crawl + HTML-to-Markdown cleanup for RAG ingestion.
cautions: AGPL server: review before self-hosting inside a commercial service; the hosted API bills per page.
Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
install: Use the MIT SDK (@mendable/firecrawl-js or firecrawl-py) against the hosted API, or review AGPL before self-hosting.

items.name: Apify SDK

license.scope: Apache-2.0; the Apify platform is a paid service.

items.summary: SDK for building Apify Actors (packaged scrapers/automations) in JavaScript or Python.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing deployment, storage and scheduling glue when running scrapers on the Apify platform.
cautions: Platform usage is billed; set memory/timeouts and budget alerts.
Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: PyAutoGUI
items.summary: Cross-platform Python library for controlling mouse and keyboard and taking screenshots.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing OS-specific input synthesis for simple desktop automation.
cautions: Keep the fail-safe (move to corner) enabled; coordinate scripts break when screens change.
Releases are infrequent; prefer accessibility APIs where available.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: nut.js

license.scope: Source is Apache-2.0, but maintained prebuilt packages are distributed via a paid subscription registry.

items.summary: Node.js desktop automation: keyboard, mouse, screen and image-based element search.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing native input bindings for desktop automation in Node.js (robotjs is unmaintained).
cautions: Public npm packages were removed; prebuilt binaries need a subscription or building from source.
Run automation in an isolated session with least-privilege accounts.
install: Review the current distribution terms; build from source or obtain the official subscription packages.

items.name: n8n

license.scope: Fair-code Sustainable Use License (not OSI); enterprise features under n8n Enterprise License. Internal business use allowed; reselling or hosting for others needs a commercial agreement.

items.summary: Node-based workflow automation platform with 400+ integrations, code nodes and AI agent nodes.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing integration glue and scheduled sync jobs for internal workflows.
cautions: Do not embed or copy n8n code into a commercial product without rights (Sustainable Use License).
Credentials live in n8n; set N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY and restrict access.
install: Review the license; self-host the official Docker image pinned to a version, or use n8n Cloud.

items.name: Node-RED

license.scope: Apache-2.0; community nodes have their own licenses.

items.summary: Flow-based low-code programming tool for wiring APIs, devices and services, popular for IoT.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing event-routing glue for IoT, MQTT and simple integration flows.
cautions: Enable adminAuth; an open editor allows arbitrary code execution.
Review community nodes before installing; they run with full privileges.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Activepieces

license.scope: MIT for the community edition; packages/ee is under a commercial license.

items.summary: Open-source no-code automation platform (Zapier alternative) with TypeScript "pieces" and MCP support.
items.useWhen: Use instead of building a Zapier-style trigger/action automation layer for users.
cautions: Exclude the ee directory unless you hold a commercial license.
Secure credentials and sandbox code steps.
install: Self-host the official image pinned to a release with Docker Compose; set encryption keys from secrets.

items.name: Windmill

license.scope: AGPL-3.0 core with Apache-2.0 clients; enterprise features are proprietary.

items.summary: Developer platform that turns Python/TypeScript/Go/Bash scripts into workflows, UIs and scheduled jobs.
items.useWhen: Use instead of building internal job runners, script UIs and workflow orchestration from scratch.
cautions: AGPL-3.0: review before embedding or offering as a service; some features need an enterprise license.
Scripts run with worker credentials; isolate workers.
install: Review the license; self-host with the official Docker Compose pinned to a release.

items.name: Huginn
items.summary: Self-hosted Ruby agents that watch the web, collect events and take automated actions.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing personal monitoring, scraping and notification bots.
cautions: Release cadence is slow; run in Docker and keep dependencies patched.
Respect site terms of service, robots.txt, rate limits and personal-data law; do not bypass access controls or CAPTCHAs.
install: Run the official container pinned to a digest; follow the wiki for configuration.

items.name: Trigger.dev

license.scope: Apache-2.0 for the self-hostable platform; the @trigger.dev/sdk package is MIT. Cloud is a paid service.

items.summary: TypeScript background jobs and long-running workflows with retries, queues and observability.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing job queues, retries and long-running task orchestration in TypeScript apps.
cautions: Cloud usage is billed by compute; set concurrency and max duration.
install: Install with the project's package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.
